Name: Crucifigo's Joja Animals - Expanded
Author: bezajel
Description:
[b]
[/b]An update and expansion to Crucifigo's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/598]Joja Animal Abominations[/url]﻿. This mod changes coop and barn animals to Joja alternatives.


[b]Features:
[/b]
[list]
[*]All crucifigo's original Joja animals: Chickens, Ducks, Rabbits, Cows, Goats, Sheep, and Pigs.
[*]New art for Joja Ostriches and Dinosaurs.
[/list][list]
[*]Crucifigo's original Deluxe Coop and Barn (slightly edited).
[*]New variants for starter and Big Coop and Barn, so you can support Joja through all building upgrades.
[/list][list]
[*]Ability to enable each animal or building type individually.
[/list][list]
[*]Portrait and sprite changes for consistency when Joja animals are included in events. (Off by default)
[/list][b]How to Install
[/b]
[list]
[*]Unzip and place in your mods folder.
[*]Set up your portrait and sprite options in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿ if you want them enabled.
[/list]
[b]Compatibility
[/b]
[list]
[*]You can turn each animal off, so it can be mixed and matched with other animal replacers.
[*]Compatible with AT mods.
[*]Portrait and sprite compatibility with ﻿Nyapu, OhoDavi, Seasonal Cute, and DSV (Shane only in vanilla variant at this stage).
[/list]

[b]Future Updates
[/b]
[list]
[*]Make a version that creates Joja variants as completely new animal types purchasable from Marnie's
[*]Include options for Joja pets and (perhaps) wildlife?
[*]Portrait support for Ecuadorian Shane (DSV), if I can get permission.
[*]Possible (and optional) dialogue/event changes so Shane doesn't diss Joja chickens while holding a Joja chicken.
[*]Possible replacement of produce with Joja varieties.
[/list]

[b]Credits[/b]

[list]
[*]The original art is by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Crucifigo]Crucifigo[/url]﻿, who has open permission for modifications and improvements.
[/list][list]
[*]I made the Ostrich and Dinosaur sprites in Crucifigo's colour palette.
[*]I also extended the Duck sprites with their swimming animations.
[*]I created the Coop, Big Coop, and Big Barn based on Crucifigo's Deluxe Coop and Barn, and made minor edits to the Deluxe Barn.
[*]I edited [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/RainbowGirl2124]RainbowGirl2124[/url]﻿'s Barn from her [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39440]AT Animal Abominations[/url]﻿ as a template for door placement. She also has open permission for modifications and improvements.
[*]I created the animal shop icons from existing assets, and drew the overlays for Shane and Marnie's sprites, Haley's cow photos, and Shane's portraits.
[*]I wrote all the CP.
[/list]
